description: This Java source file defines a utility class ServiceConfigUtil that manages loading, caching, and accessing service configuration data from an XML file 'serviceengine.xml'. It includes methods for retrieving engine parameters, getting service engine configurations, registering listeners for configuration changes, and internal logic for parsing XML and caching configurations.

methods.name: getEngineParameter
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specific parameter from the specified service engine configuration.

methods.name: getServiceConfig
methods.description: Returns the singleton ServiceConfig instance, loading and caching it if necessary. Notifies registered listeners upon reload.

methods.name: getServiceEngine
methods.description: Returns a named ServiceEngine configuration, or null if not found.

methods.name: registerServiceConfigListener
methods.description: Adds a listener that will be notified when the service configuration is reloaded.

methods.name: getEngine
methods.description: Returns the name of the current service engine, which is 'default'.

methods.name: getServiceEngineXmlFileName
methods.description: Returns the filename of the service engine XML configuration, 'serviceengine.xml'.
